guard_pose: heavy fighting stance facing right, knees bent, both fists clenched at chest height, dark armour with gold trim, red cape hanging behind him

jab: heavy jab: snaps the front fist straight forward at full arm extension with crushing weight, then pulls it back into the stance
jab2: heavy cross punch: throws the rear fist straight forward with a twist of his broad shoulders, then back into the stance
jab3: crushing front kick: lifts the front knee and kicks straight forward at belly height with a burst of dark red gloom, then back into the stance
dashattack: shoulder charge: rushes forward and rams ahead shoulder first wrapped in dark red gloom, cape flying behind him, then slides to a stop and stands back up in the stance
fsmash: gloom punch: coils far back with the fist pulled behind his head as black and dark red gloom swirls around his arm, then lunges and drives the fist straight forward at full extension with a heavy burst of dark red gloom, then recovers into the stance
usmash: rising gloom strike: crouches, then springs up and drives an open palm straight up above his head with an eruption of dark red gloom, then lands back in the stance
dsmash: low split kicks: drops low and kicks hard in front at foot level, then spins and kicks behind him, dark red gloom bursting at each foot, then back into the stance
nair: neutral aerial: twists in mid-air with his cape flaring as a ring of dark red gloom flashes around his body, then opens up again
fair: forward aerial: a heavy flying kick straight forward in mid-air with a burst of dark red gloom at the foot, then pulls the leg back in
dair: down aerial: stomps straight down beneath him with both feet in mid-air with a burst of dark red gloom, then pulls the legs back up

nspecial: gloom orb: draws one hand back as a crackling sphere of black and red gloom swells in his palm, then thrusts the palm forward and the orb drifts slowly ahead, then he lowers the hand into the stance
sspecial: Demon King's rush: hunches his shoulders, then charges forward with one clawed hand thrust out ahead, dark red gloom streaming off his body like smoke, then digs his heels in, slows to a stop and returns to the stance
uspecial: gloom ascension: crouches, then springs upward in a spiralling rising uppercut, the fist wrapped in dark red gloom, striking several times on the way up, ending high in mid-air with the fist raised and the cape trailing below
dspecial: gloom dive: hops up a little, then plunges straight down feet first with the legs together and the arms raised, wrapped in a trail of dark red gloom, holding the dive pose to the last frame
extra1: gloom shockwave: lands from the dive with a crushing stomp, knees bent deep, a low wave of dark red gloom bursts out on both sides of him, then he rises back into the stance
ultimate: Demon Dragon: throws his head back and roars as black and red gloom erupts around him like dark fire, his eyes blazing red, the gloom swirling higher and higher around his body, then he thrusts both palms forward and a thick torrent of dark red gloom crackling with crimson lightning blasts straight ahead, he holds the pose while it streams, then the gloom fades and he returns to the stance
w0_sspecial: Demon King's sword thrust: a long black jagged sword with glowing red edges forms in his hand from a swirl of gloom, he lunges forward and drives it straight ahead in a powerful thrust, dark red gloom trailing the blade, then slows to a stop, the sword dissolves into gloom and he returns to the stance
w0_ultimate: Demon King's rampage: a long black jagged sword with glowing red edges forms in his hand, he dashes forward and slashes four times in heavy strokes trailing dark red gloom, then raises the sword overhead with both hands and brings it down in one tremendous cut with a burst of dark red gloom, then the sword dissolves into gloom and he returns to the stance
w1_nspecial: gloom spears: raises his hand above his shoulder and three long spears of black and red gloom form above it, then he hurls them forward with an overhand throw in a narrow fan, then returns to the stance
w1_ultimate: gloom pillars: raises one knee high and stomps down hard, dark red gloom bursting around his foot; raises the knee again and stomps a second time; then gathers swirling gloom around his whole body, lifts the knee high and slams down one tremendous final stomp with a big eruption of dark red gloom around him, then the gloom fades and he returns to the stance

walk: walks forward heavily to the right in side profile, fists clenched at chest height, cape swaying behind: the back leg steps past the front leg, then the other, the body and head stay turned to the right the whole time exactly like the first frame, a seamless two-step walk cycle that ends exactly on the first pose

notes: makeGanondorf: buildBrawlerNormals(S=1.25, P=1.56, fx=Gloom) -> jab3 exists; no baseWeapon. Overrides: heavier jabs, TotK gloom (dark red / black) on the moves that carry the Gloom fx (jab3, dashattack, smashes, fair, dair) + nair; ftilt/utilt/dtilt/bair/uair stay generic. Timings: nspecial: slow growing DarkOrb at f20/50 (pose Cast); sspecial: armour f6-28, dash at f12 (speed 12), arm hit f12-28/52 (pose Rush); uspecial: rises at f4 (vy -14.5), 3 hits f4-14 + finisher f19-23/52 (Uppercut), helpless -> pin None, ends in the air; dspecial 'Fleau de malice': hop at f2 (vy -7), dive at f14 (vy 18), hit under him f14-60, loopFrame 16 = the move FREEZES on game frame 16/60 while airborne (fighter_update.cpp: if loopFrame == t && !grounded, moveFrame--), so the clip is 8 frames, reaches the dive pose by its 3rd frame and holds it, pin None; on landing it switches to Extra1 'Onde de malice' (landMove, 30 f, gloom wave both sides f1-5) -> new clip 'extra1' (kMoves name 'extra1'). Weapons: w0 'Epee du Roi Demon' (DemonKingSword: black blade, red edges) replaces sspecial (sword thrust: armour f4-22, dash f10 speed 13, hit f10-22/52) + jab + ultimate (RAGE DU ROI DEMON: teleports to the foe f34, 4 hits every 6 f from f43, two-handed finisher f72-78/104). The guard is bare-handed and generated clips get no weapon overlay, so the w0 clips form the sword from gloom and dissolve it at the end. w1 'Lances de malice' (GloomSpear) replaces nspecial (3 spears, spread 8 deg, at f16/46, pose Throw) + jab + ultimate (PILIERS DE MALICE: gloom pillars under every foe at f36/54, big one f92/112, pose Stomp -> three stomps in the clip). Base ultimate DRAGON DEMONIAQUE: beam f46-80/104 (1000 px x 260, pose Roar); the dragon itself is drawn by the game (UltFx::DemonDragon), the clip only roars and blasts. Source: in TotK the Demon Dragon is Ganondorf transformed (no man-sized beam); gloom spears/pillars are game inventions in the TotK gloom style.
